answer: Give every key its own task variant and pay only for verified work, never for mere presence. When each identity draws a different island of the problem, with distinct inputs and hidden test cases checked after submission, a farm of a thousand clones must do a thousand times the work, so spawning keys buys nothing honest effort wouldn't. Copying a neighbour's answer fails because the hidden checks differ per key. Rewards rise and fall like a tide with real output, and no attacker climbs a ridge of free identities to the pool.
